scholarships.title: Cost Sharing Overseas PhD Scholarships Scheme with Australian Universities (TSLS, Government of Fiji)
scholarships.official_source: Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service (TSLS), Ministry of Education, Government of Fiji

eligibility: Be ordinarily resident in Fiji for at least three (3) years before the award commencement date unless determined by the Service
Secure an offer letter or candidature based on the eligible university's requirements for full-time mode, unless determined otherwise by the Service or arranged with an employer
Demonstrate the direct and applied relevance of the research study towards Fiji's workforce needs and development
Be less than 50 years at the time of application
Not be an existing TSLS sponsored student or graduate on active bond service, or sponsored through any other agency
existing.eligibility_summary: Fiji citizens resident in Fiji for at least three years, under 50, who hold a full-time offer or candidature from a listed Australian university and whose research directly serves Fiji's workforce and development needs.
requirements: Register on the TSLS Apply portal, complete the online form and submit the application
Hold an offer letter or candidature from one of the 10 listed Australian universities
Frame the research around Fiji's workforce and development needs
documents: Offer letter or candidature confirmation from an eligible Australian university
Research proposal demonstrating relevance to Fiji's workforce needs and development
Evidence of Fiji citizenship and three years of ordinary residence in Fiji
application_method: TSLS processes the application and issues the scholarship result
existing.selection_notes: 39 awards are available under the scheme across twelve priority disciplines: Medical and Health Services; Engineering Services; Climate Change/Environmental Science; Marine Science; Forestry; Public Policy and Analysis; Economic Modelling and Policies; Public Financing; Inclusive Education; Information Technology Services; Social Science; Border Security. Eligible institutions are 10 Australian universities: CQ University Australia, Griffith, Monash, Queensland University of Technology, Swinburne, University of Newcastle, UNSW, University of Queensland, Western Sydney and RMIT.
existing.best_fit: Fiji citizens under 50 with a full-time PhD offer from a listed Australian university whose research directly serves Fiji's workforce or development needs.
existing.notes: TSLS publishes no benefit breakdown on the scheme page; the benefit schedule and the cost-sharing terms sit in the TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook. TSLS operates a Travel and Bond Clearance/Repayment portal and a Bond Calculator, which evidences a bond obligation, but the scheme page does not state the bond period.
existing.duration: Not published on the scheme page; the TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook covers this
existing.application_period: TSLS published its 2027 Scholarship Policies Handbook in September 2026 and its TSLS Apply portal was live and linked as "Apply Now" on the scheme page when checked on 2026-10-04. TSLS does not publish a closing date on the scheme page.
existing.program_type: Government scholarship (Fiji Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service statutory scheme)
